name: Anchor
author: pedro
summary: Larger A/B target controls and native detection of prepared loops, including paused B.
description: Align a chosen point on B with an outgoing phrase or hot cue. Pick B phrase starts, Hot Cues or Set here in Ribbon, Card or Sidebar. Larger A/B target controls; no unavailable jump button. B targets stay fixed through beat jumps and loop changes. On verified EP147 2.00 firmware, a read-only worker reads current working loop boundaries even while B is paused. Other firmware uses observed repeated wraps. Bar.beat counters keep a large bar numeral and smaller beat suffix, turning amber in the final bar. No deck control, hooks or network.
